description: Run another sequence A/B test after a winner is selected. By default the winner becomes the new control; pass sourceVariantId to use another variant as the control email.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

sourceVariantId.description: Optional variant ID to use as the new control email. Defaults to the selected winner.

testType.description: Optional test type: subject or content.

variantCount.description: Optional total variants including the control. Must be from 2 to 4.

winnerThreshold.description: Optional number of subscribers before selecting a winner. Must be from 10 to 1000.

name: restart_ab_test

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `restart_ab_test` MCP tool.

abTest.description: The A/B test record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
